# Sahi Apps

Sahi Apps makes simple, offline Android apps built in India. No sign-in, no data
collection, free with ads. Contact: hello@sahiapps.com

## Apps

- EMI Calculator (https://sahiapps.com/emi-calculator/): calculates loan EMI,
  SIP, FD and RD for India, e.g. ₹25 lakh at 8.5% for 20 years = ₹21,696/month.
- Unit Converter (https://sahiapps.com/unit-converter/): converts length,
  weight, temperature, area, volume, speed, time and data, e.g. 37°C = 98.6°F.
- Days Until (https://sahiapps.com/days-until/): counts days until or since
  any date, e.g. days until Diwali or a birthday.
- Tip Calculator (https://sahiapps.com/tip-calculator/): splits a bill and tip
  among any number of people, e.g. ₹2,450 bill + 10% tip = ₹673.75 per person
  for 4 people.
- Age Calculator (https://sahiapps.com/age-calculator/): finds exact age in
  years, months and days from a date of birth, plus days to next birthday.
- BMI Calculator (https://sahiapps.com/bmi-calculator/): calculates BMI, BMR
  (Mifflin-St Jeor) and daily calories, e.g. BMI = weight(kg) / height(m)^2.
- GST Calculator (https://sahiapps.com/gst-calculator/): adds or removes GST
  from an amount and splits CGST/SGST/IGST for India's GST slabs.
- Byaj Calculator (https://sahiapps.com/byaj-calculator/): calculates byaj
  (sekda), simple and compound interest, e.g. ₹2 sekda = 24% per year.
- Land Area Converter (https://sahiapps.com/land-area-converter/): converts
  bigha, guntha, katha and other Indian land units, e.g. 1 acre = 40 guntha.
- Voice Recorder (https://sahiapps.com/voice-recorder/): transcribes voice
  recordings offline on-device with speaker labels and translation, e.g.
  Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali, Kannada, Marathi, Gujarati and more.

Full site: https://sahiapps.com/
Privacy policy: https://sahiapps.com/privacy.html
